caption: The drawing depicts a stylized horse with a raised front left leg, rendered in side profile facing to the right. The horse's body is colored in a light grayish tone, with shading and texture lines giving the appearance of carved wood. The mane and tail are rendered in dark gray, with wavy lines indicating hair texture. The horse is outfitted with a decorative saddle that is tan with a large, red oval panel in the center, trimmed with light blue and outlined subtly in gray. A red and blue harness encircles the horse’s body near the chest, and another matches around the hindquarters. The bridle and reins are also red with some gold details, including a circular ornament on the bridle. The hooves are dark gray to black, except for the front right hoof, which is tan. The background is a plain, uncolored off-white, and there are no additional objects or scenery present in the composition.
title: Carousel Horse
